disagreement.point: Whether to proceed immediately to a dyadic partial-summation estimate.
disagreement.majority: No. First determine whether the source series is absolutely convergent / reorderable and specify a synchronized cutoff.
disagreement.minority: A finite-shell definition is always algebraically possible and may be explored in parallel, but only as a telescoping representation with no independent-limit claim.

strongest_objection: A naive infinite log-window decomposition can be mathematically ill-defined or summation-method dependent even before the RH-strength audit; proving estimates on such pieces would be wasted work.
uncertainties: Exact source wording/convergence status of Coffey's S_Lambda series must be checked in the primary body, not inferred from the abstract.
Even after a synchronized decomposition, all-n tail control may remain root-strength or require unavailable n-uniform Laguerre asymptotics.
No bounded search can certify literature novelty of the convergence/gluing observation.
next_action_recommendation: Freeze trace, then inspect Coffey's exact definition/proof and test absolute convergence/rearrangement. If non-absolute, formulate the minimal synchronized-shell normal form and classify the resulting local/gluing residual; only then consider prime-sum estimates.
